title: Build and run the first Flex scanner
description: Recorded commands from Part 1 of the Flex/Bison tutorial. Compiler tools are installed in the recorder image before the session. Compiler versions and diagnostics can vary.

setup: apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq flex bison >/dev/null

markers.title: Read the scanner rules
markers.note: The tutorial scanner recognizes numbers and lowercase words.

markers.title: Compile and link
markers.note: GCC links the generated C source with the Flex library.

markers.title: Run the sample input
markers.note: The scanner prints the words and numbers from the tutorial input.
